canonical_example.text:
meus suspiros formai vento,
com que me façais ir ter
canonical_example.translation:
may my thought sail:
my sighs, may you form wind,
with which may you make me go
where I desire to see myself;

canonical_example.text:
Eu não tenho tempo pra falar teu nome
Eu não tenho nome pra você dizer
Meu café jamais vai matar tua fome
Nada que tu traga vai me apetecer
canonical_example.translation:
I have no time to speak your name
I have no name for you to say
My coffee will never sate your hunger
 Nothing you bring will please me.

meanings.translation: to please; to be of interest

canonical_example.text: Estou perfeitamente satisfeito com a segurança que tenho [...]
canonical_example.translation: I am perfectly satisfied with the security I have …

canonical_example.text: Eu quase acertei!
canonical_example.translation: I almost got it right!

meanings.translation: to pay, to settle (a bill etc.)

canonical_example.text: “Cara, você pode morrer se fizer isso.” “Azar.”
canonical_example.translation: “Dude, you could die if you do this.” “I don’t care.”

features.embedding_text: indicates that the speaker doesn’t care about the negative consequences mentioned
features.value: indicates that the speaker doesn’t care about the negative consequences mentioned

meanings.translation: tough luck; big deal; I don’t care

canonical_example.text: Foi muito azar ter perdido aquele livro.
canonical_example.translation: Losing that book was some real bad luck.

meanings.translation: to listen to; to hear (to perceive sound)
plastic (a stiff but usually slightly flexible synthetic material)
to find one's place (to discover one's vocation)

canonical_example.text: Posso ajudá-lo a encontrar tudo...
canonical_example.translation: I can help you to find everything...

meanings.translation: to find oneself (to learn what kind of person one is)
stellar (of, pertaining to, or characteristic of stars)
mode; way; method (method or manner of doing something)
European Portuguese standard form of planejar
prone to display sympathy; sympathetic; nice

canonical_example.text: Eles nos contaram que quase morreram.
canonical_example.translation: They told us that they almost died.

canonical_example.text: Às vezes precisamos contar umas mentiras.
canonical_example.translation: Sometimes we need to tell some lies.

meanings.translation: to tell; to narrate (relate a story or series of events)

canonical_example.text: O seu primeiro filho conta já dezoito anos.
canonical_example.translation: His firstborn is already eighteen years old.

unused_menu_senses.translation: to be [an amount of time] old; to have [an amount of time] of existence

canonical_example.text: Aquele ponto não contou, porque o jogador fez falta.
canonical_example.translation: That point didn’t count, because the player made a foul.

unused_menu_senses.translation: to count; to matter (be of significance)

canonical_example.text: Contamos contigo para trazer a munição.
canonical_example.translation: We are counting on you to bring the ammunition.

canonical_example.text: Contei vinte maçãs.
canonical_example.translation: I counted twenty apples.

canonical_example.text: Nosso país conta com um exército medíocre.
canonical_example.translation: Our country has a mediocre army.

unused_menu_senses.translation: to have at one’s disposal; to have available

canonical_example.text: Consegui comprar uma casa barata.
canonical_example.translation: I was able to buy a cheap house.

unused_menu_senses.translation: to sell oneself short, to cheapen oneself
to conduct business only with money, to not barter

canonical_example.text: Essa porcaria de celular barato não durou um dia.
canonical_example.translation: That bloody cheap mobile didn’t last a day.

unused_menu_senses.translation: cheap; worthless (low in worth or quality)

canonical_example.text: Esse livro é o maior barato!
canonical_example.translation: That book is a lot of fun!

unused_menu_senses.translation: high (period of excitement or relaxation caused by drug use)
to get disordered, to get messed up

canonical_example.text: O professor não me dá folga!
canonical_example.translation: The teacher doesn’t give me a break.

meanings.translation: respite; break (a brief interval of rest or relief)

canonical_example.text: Amanhã é meu dia de folga.
canonical_example.translation: Tomorrow is my day off.

canonical_example.text: A corda tem muita folga, precisamos amarrá-la melhor.
canonical_example.translation: The rope has too much slack, we need to tie it better.

unused_menu_senses.translation: slack (extent to which a part of a mechanism can move freely)
to slacken, to loosen (make less tight)

canonical_example.text: Podem se aproximar, não estou armado.
canonical_example.translation: You can approach, I’m not armed.

canonical_example.text: Não se aproxime daquela região, está contaminada.
canonical_example.translation: Don’t approach that region, it’s contaminated.

canonical_example.text: É difícil aproximar os polos iguais de um par de ímãs.
canonical_example.translation: It’s hard to put the equal poles of a pair of magnets near one another.

meanings.translation: to approach (to make things get nearer)

canonical_example.text: Não tivemos tempo para medir a área então aproximamos um valor.
canonical_example.translation: We didn’t have time to measure the area, so we estimated a value.

unused_menu_senses.translation: to approximate; to estimate (to calculate roughly)

canonical_example.text: Você não manda em mim, morou?
canonical_example.translation: I don't take orders from you, got it?

canonical_example.text: Eles o chamaram de idiota, de mentiroso.
canonical_example.translation: They called him an idiot, a liar.
